facebook.content:
When the Kingdom calls you to steward your finances, it isn’t about “saving”—it’s about “sowing.” Deuteronomy 8:18 declares, “It is the Lord who gives you the power to get wealth.” The power belongs to you now, not after you’ve accumulated enough. Your income is a Kingdom seedfield; every dollar you give back to God multiplies for His purpose.  

What one expense will you convert into a seed today?

instagram.content:
Authority isn’t a title; it’s the throne you inherit in Christ.  
When you speak as a Kingdom ambassador, every word carries the weight of God’s decree.  

“Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven” — Matt 18:18  

Are you binding your life to the Kingdom’s purpose or to the world’s agenda?
